target: ischaemic heart disease (coronary artery disease or previous infarction)

mri.source: out-of-fold predictions, logistic_C10, 100 ACDC training patients, expert masks

assumptions: The health-record, ECG and MRI findings are independent given the true state.
ECG and MRI evidence of infarction applies to coronary artery disease as the health-record model defines it (angiographic narrowing).
No dataset with all three for the same patients exists publicly, so the combined probability is not validated.
